entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't jump to conclusions! Over here!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Where are we supposed to get out from[n]here!? There aren't even any windows!
entries.uk: І як нам звідси вибратися!?[n]Тут навіть вікон немає!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is the most basic of basics.
Are we going to die here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right! As I thought, you're a natural[n]at this.
entries.uk: Саме так! Я так і думав — у тебе[n]природний хист.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It leads all the way outside.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We would've done that earlier if that was[n]possible!
entries.uk: Якби це було можливо, ми б давно[n]так і зробили!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The ventilation shaft, you morons![n]You guys should be able to squeeze[n]through it one at a time.
entries.uk: Вентиляційна шахта, бовдури![n]Ви маєте пролізти нею[n]по одному.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right. Everything's hopeless and[n]black like my fur— Now why would I die[n]here with you two!?
entries.uk: Атож. Усе безнадійно й чорне, як моя[n]шерсть... Та чого б це мені помирати[n]тут із вами двома!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The ventilation shaft, you morons![n]You guys should be able to squeeze[n]through it one at a time.
entries.uk: Вентиляційна шахта, бовдури![n]Ви маєте пролізти нею[n]по одному.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Then we just gotta get that metallic[n]mesh off!
entries.uk: Тоді треба лише зняти ту металеву[n]решітку!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Oww... Crap! The enemy didn't hear us,[n]did they?
entries.uk: Ай... Чорт! Вороги ж нас[n]не почули, ні?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Seriously, we're finally gettin' outta here!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You should wait on celebrating until you[n]actually get out.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's something that I still have to do.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heh, you better be careful too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.uk: Ці двоє, схоже, можуть стати в пригоді...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Especially the frizzy-haired one, if my[n]judgment's right...
